! I fear that he may change your religion, or that he may cause mischief to appear in the land!"

40:27.text: said: "Verily I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant who believes not in the Day of Reckoning!"

40:28.text: And a believing man of Fir‘aun’s
family, who hid his faith said: "Would you kill a man because he says: My Lord is Allâh, and he has come to you with clear signs
from your Lord? And if he is a liar, upon him will be
his lie; but if he is telling the truth, then some of that
wherewith he threatens you will befall on you." Verily, Allâh guides not one who is a Musrif
(a polytheist, or a murderer who shed blood without a right, or those who commit great sins, oppressor, transgressor)

40:29.text: "O my people! Yours is the kingdom today, you being dominant in the land. But who will save us from the Torment of Allâh, should it befall us?" Fir‘aun
said: "I show you only that which I see
, and I guide you only to the path of right policy!"

40:30.text: And he who believed said: "O my people! Verily, I fear for you a fate like that day

40:31.text: "Like the fate of the people of Nûh
, and ‘Âd, and Thamûd and those who came after them. And Allâh wills no injustice for

40:32.text: "And, O my people! Verily, I fear for you the Day when there will be mutual calling
(between the people of Hell and of Paradise)

40:33.text: A Day when you will turn your backs and flee having no protector from Allâh. And whomsoever Allâh sends astray, for him there is no guide.
